title: Mod Manager
noGame: No game install detected — set the game path in Settings first.
empty: No recognizable mods under res_mods yet. Install one from the online catalog.
installHint: Point at an unpacked mod folder (voice pack, PnF skin, ribbon icons, ime_config patch). .zip/.7z need extracting for now.
catalogHint: Curated tool-type mods from the WoWSP mod hub. Each ships with a version and a SHA-256; install downloads straight from the project's GitHub release.
catalogEmpty: Catalog is empty — press Refresh to fetch the online list.
catalogError: Failed to load the online catalog: {error}
pickHint: Pick a mod on the left to see its details.
delistedHint: "{name}" has been withdrawn from the catalog and can no longer be installed. Existing installs keep working and stay manageable under Installed.
foreignCopy: This mod is already installed by {source}. "Register & reinstall" brings it under WoWSP management and clears the foreign copy left behind (copies inside res_mods are snapshotted first).
foreignManaged: {name} was installed by {source}. You can uninstall it right here (files and {source}'s registry rows are cleaned up together), or open the paired catalog entry to register & reinstall it under WoWSP.
foreignPairedHint: Pairs with "{name}" in the online catalog.
registeredOverForeign: "{name}" is now registered with WoWSP — updates and uninstalls are managed here from now on.
modstationUninstallConfirm: Remove the ModStation mod "{name}"? Its entire directory under bin/<version>/mods/ will be deleted.
noAssets: No previewable assets under this unit.
modelNote: Holographic shape preview — paints and textures are shown as image thumbnails.
modelShellOnly: 3D model preview requires the desktop app.
bundledWithApp: Bundled with the app (auto-installed when plugin detection is enabled)
confirmUninstall: Uninstall "{name}"? Recorded files are removed; overwritten originals are restored.
unitDisabled: Disabled “{name}” — files renamed with a .bak suffix.
confirmUnitUninstall: Uninstall “{name}”? All of its files (including disabled .bak copies) are removed; overwritten originals are restored.
gameRunningBlock: World of Warships is running — close the game before installing, uninstalling or toggling mods.
staleBinBanner: Game updated — bin/{version} still holds {count} stranded mod file(s) the current client no longer loads.
staleSidebarTip: The game updated and the old version folder still holds mod files the current client no longer loads. Click to handle the migration in the mod hub.
migrateProbeNote: The in-game stats plugin was found in this old version: migration reinstalls its latest build into the current game folder automatically.
migrateProbeDone: The in-game stats plugin was reinstalled into bin/{version}.
migrateProbeFailed: The in-game stats plugin could not be reinstalled automatically — install it again from the live battle view later.
migrateScanIntro: Analyze the {count} leftover plugin files in bin/{from} and classify them by content: exact duplicates are dropped, files already covered by a newer copy stay as-is, and the rest are yours to decide one by one.
migrateScanNote: Analysis hashes every file — a heavy disk sweep that can take tens of seconds; migration also re-verifies the game is fully closed before it starts.
migrateAnalyzing: Comparing bin/{from} against the current version's res_mods…
migrateDone: Migration complete: {moved} file(s) moved into bin/{to}; {skipped} file(s) cleaned up.
migrateEmpty: The stale version holds no mod files to process.
migrateCleanupNote: Duplicates, superseded copies and install bookkeeping are cleaned up automatically; a migration never overwrites a file the current version already has.
migrateIgnore: Ignore — leave in the old version, untouched
migrateDoneIgnored: {ignored} file(s) were ignored and left as-is in bin/{from}; migrate again anytime.

migrateGroup.duplicateHint: The current version already carries a file with identical content — the stale copy is deleted, nothing is carried over.
migrateGroup.supersededHint: The current version already has a file at the same path with different content (treated as the newer install) — the stale copy is deleted.
migrateGroup.decideHint: These files exist only in the stale tree: check to migrate and keep, uncheck to delete — or ignore a row to leave it untouched.
migrateGroup.ignoredHint: Ignored files stay in the old bin exactly as they are; this migration does not touch them, and you can migrate again later.

safeModeOn: Safe mode is active — every res_mods mod is quarantined (res_mods renamed); the game runs without them. No mods can be changed until it is turned off.
safeModeHint: Game crashing? Quarantine every res_mods mod at once and test — nothing is deleted, one click brings them back.
confirmSafeModeEnter: Quarantine every res_mods mod at once? The current res_mods is renamed away (nothing is deleted) and the game loads without any of them. A few mods also drop a DLL into the game root itself — those files are not affected. Mods cannot be changed while safe mode is on, and the game must be closed.
confirmSafeModeExit: Bring every quarantined mod back? res_mods is renamed into place again, restoring exactly the state before safe mode. The game must be closed.
safeModeOnDone: Safe mode on — every mod quarantined. Launch the game to test the vanilla client.
safeModeOffDone: Mods restored — res_mods is back in place.
safeModeBlock: Safe mode is active — turn mods back on before changing them.
reconciled: Cleaned up {n} stale install record(s) that no longer match any files.
manifestOnly: No matching files found under res_mods (installer manifest entry only).
experimental: This feature is unstable and still in development — it may not work.
